from collections import Counter
def diff_summary(t):
    ab=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); aa=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if ab[r][c]!=aa[r][c]: cnt[(ab[r][c],aa[r][c])]+=1
    return dict(cnt)
res = action(['UP'])
print("UP:", diff_summary(last_transition), {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over')})
res = action(['RIGHT'])
print("RIGHT:", diff_summary(last_transition))
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('B','c') and n['pixels']>20:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], 'bbox', min(rows), min(cols), max(rows), max(cols))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
